damage_types.description: The types to compare. Defaults to the five elements. The summary counts which of them each fight takes most.

statuses.description: Statuses to report instead of, or alongside, damage. This is the 'which bosses are immune to frostbite' question.

dlc.description: True for the DLC's fights only, false for the base game's, omitted for both.

bosses.description: Substrings of fight names to restrict to — a summon pool, or the two fights a question names. Matching is loose on purpose: 'radahn' finds every Radahn.

min_health.description: Drop the small fights. Useful for 'endgame bosses', where a threshold beats a guess at a list.

sort_by.description: Default 'health', which puts the fights that matter first.

limit.description: Rows returned. The summary always counts every fight that passed the filters, not just these. Default 25.
